purpose: Practical tooling map for connecting many public datasets into an evidence graph and testing causal hypotheses without treating correlation as truth.

tools.name: DuckDB
tools.role: Local/cloud build-time analytics over CSV, Parquet and GeoParquet.
tools.fit: Cheap batch joins, profiling and release artifact creation.
caveats: Not a source of truth; keep raw snapshots immutable.

tools.name: Dagster / Prefect
tools.role: Scheduled ingestion, validation and rebuild orchestration.
tools.fit: Runs source adapters, backfills and freshness checks.
caveats: Pipeline success does not mean source data is correct.

tools.name: GeoPandas + GDAL/Rasterio
tools.role: Vector/raster normalization, CRS conversion and spatial joins.
tools.fit: Turns map/raster layers into joinable features for graph edges.
caveats: CRS, resolution and geometry semantics must be recorded.

tools.name: H3
tools.role: Common spatial grid for comparing weather, movement, events and demographics.
tools.fit: Lets unlike datasets meet in one place/time index.
caveats: Grid aggregation can hide local extremes and boundary effects.

tools.name: KuzuDB
tools.role: Embedded graph database for entity/factor/evidence relationships.
tools.fit: Good for offline graph builds and agent queries.
caveats: Expose provenance; do not expose graph links as conclusions.

tools.name: PostGIS
tools.role: Operational spatial database for validated geometry joins.
tools.fit: Best when street/catchment/asset-level queries become dynamic.
caveats: More ops overhead than static Cloudflare artifacts.

tools.name: PyWhy / DoWhy
tools.role: Explicit causal model, assumptions, refutation tests and effect estimation.
tools.fit: Tests a named hypothesis after graph evidence suggests one.
caveats: Requires a causal DAG and assumptions; cannot prove causation from metadata alone.

tools.name: EconML
tools.fit: Useful for intervention-style questions across places/groups.
caveats: Needs treatment/outcome/control data and careful leakage checks.

tools.name: Tigramite
tools.role: Time-series causal discovery for lagged relationships.
caveats: Discovery is hypothesis generation; confounding and autocorrelation remain risks.

tools.name: CausalImpact / synthetic controls
tools.role: Before/after intervention analysis with counterfactual controls.
tools.fit: Policy, infrastructure or disruption effect studies.
caveats: Needs a clear intervention date and credible controls.

tools.name: WeatherBench
caveats: Weather accuracy is not downstream outcome accuracy.

tools.name: Cloudflare Pages + Workers + R2 + D1
tools.role: Low-cost public portal, read-only MCP/API and artifact hosting.
tools.fit: Makes the graph accessible to users and agents without local setup.
caveats: Large artifacts belong in R2; APIs should be paginated and read-only by default.

workflow: build factor/evidence graph with confidence and missingness
generate hypotheses from repeated graph patterns
test hypotheses with causal tools and counterfactual design
publish evidence, assumptions, failed tests and caveats through MCP/API
caveats: Causation exists, but the system must separate candidate mechanisms, observational correlations, tested effects and official findings.
The graph should make missing confounders visible rather than hiding them behind confident prose.
